description: One chat backend for many model providers: LM Studio, any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral, Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM) and Anthropic. Model sections with search, presets, prompt caching and per-reply token usage, plus the CodeTerm tool loop.
configHelp: Domios Router (plugin id `lmstudio`) routes a chat pane to any registered provider. Kinds: `openai` (GET {baseUrl}/models, POST /chat/completions; OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral, Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM, custom), `anthropic` (/v1/models, /v1/messages) and `lmstudio` (native /api/v0 + /api/v1). Model ids are `provider::model`; bare ids belong to the LM Studio provider. Keys live only in the plugin secret store: paste them in the Router view, or `printf %s "$KEY" | codeterm plugin config lmstudio --secret <slot>` where slot is a declared api_key field such as openrouter_api_key or custom1_api_key. A remote host needs `codeterm plugin settings lmstudio --allow-host <host[:port]>`. Agent verbs: `providers`, `add-provider <id> <openai|anthropic|lmstudio> <baseUrl> [--name NAME] [--key-slot SLOT]`, `remove-provider <id>`, `test-provider <id>`, `set-default <provider>`, `models [provider] [query] [--refresh]`, `presets`, `add-preset <id> <provider::model> [--name NAME] [--temperature N] [--max-tokens N] [--system TEXT]`, `remove-preset <id>`. LM Studio turns a CodeTerm pane into an open agent shell. It uses LM Studio native v1 endpoints: POST /api/v1/chat for stateful streaming chat and GET /api/v1/models for model discovery. To use it: in LM Studio load a model and Developer tab → Start Server (defaults to http://localhost:1234). Knobs (set with `codeterm plugin config lmstudio --set key=value` or edit config.yaml): `baseUrl` — server address, including a remote or Tailscale endpoint; `model` — fallback model id; `defaultPreset` — fallback preset id; `presets` — array of {id,name,systemPrompt?,model?,params?}. On CodeTerm 1.12.4 and later, a remote endpoint also needs a host grant with `codeterm plugin settings lmstudio --allow-host <host:port>`, and CodeTerm attaches an optional stored Supporter token to requests without exposing it to the plugin. A preset with `model` binds to that exact model id and is selected before an explicit preset request. Watcher mode: spawn with `codeterm agent spawn lmstudio --role Watcher --parent <orch> --charter charter:watcher-orchestration --interval 90s` (read-only; host tick loop). `charters` — map of named watcher charter bodies; reference at spawn with `--charter charter:<id>`. Canonical template: prompts/watcher-orchestration.md. Verdict JSON: {status: ok|attention|stalled, summary, state, actions:[{kind:nudge|notify|report, pane?, message}]}. Chat engine: optional `engine: { kind: chat, window: { maxMessages } }` bounds history; `engine: { kind: machine, charter }` is a state machine (watcher or interactive).
